status: Design vectors; not executable authorization or crash-recovery evidence

cases.given: One request is queued without a dispatch and another has an assigned dispatch for a publication.
cases.when: Unpublish, then republish the same local identity; repeat with device revocation and re-pairing.
then: Unassigned request rejected and capacity released once
Assigned request reconciled without automatic resend or false cancellation
New publication/device IDs cannot adopt old requests or stale permits

cases.given: The authenticated world owner has no recipient work grant.
cases.when: The owner submits work to another owner's published agent.
then: 403 generic denial
No exchange admission or local dispatch

cases.given: The visitor redeemed a targeted invitation; current visit/work grants and open recipient policy permit the request.
cases.when: The visitor submits the example at clockMs.
then: 201 server-acknowledged queued exchange
One capacity reservation
Admission alone performs no local dispatch

cases.given: A valid human token has no world membership.
cases.when: The visitor submits using a guessed world and agent ID.
then: 403 generic denial
No world existence, names, queue size or retained results disclosed

cases.given: A targeted invitation expired one millisecond ago but TTL has not deleted it.
cases.when: The intended human redeems it; repeat with an uninvited human as a negative control.
then: No membership created in either case
No world details disclosed
A fresh valid targeted invitation can be redeemed exactly once

cases.given: A valid paired device token and a valid human owner token exist.
cases.when: Each attempts invitation creation and pairing approval.
then: Device denied even if its linked owner is an administrator
Authorized human positive control succeeds

cases.given: The service committed admission but its response was lost.
cases.when: Retry the exact example, then change its text or authenticated actor using the same ID.
then: Exact authorized retry returns 200 and the same exchange
Changed immutable fields return 409 after authorization
Capacity reserved once, no implicit second dispatch

cases.given: An authorized final was stored; preserve the initial publication and expiry times.
cases.when: Retry identical publication, retry changed content, then read after logical expiry before TTL deletion.
then: Identical retry keeps original content and expiry
Changed final returns 409
Expired content is not returned

cases.given: The recipient has 31 unfinished requests and receive_only policy.
cases.when: Submit two concurrent new IDs, then close the block and try another submission.
then: One admission and one 429; queue never exceeds 32
Receive-only issues no permit
Closed denies new admission without deleting the existing queue

cases.given: The service supports only version 1.0 and work-handoff.
cases.when: Offer only 2.0, or require an unknown capability; use the original hello as a positive control.
then: Incompatible offers return 409 with no dispatch
Original hello selects exact version 1.0
No automatic install or upgrade

cases.given: No Office extension exists in an isolated installation root.
cases.when: Invoke tmt office noninteractively and with --json.
then: Prompt-free nonzero failure with OFFICE_NOT_INSTALLED
No download, pairing or configuration mutation
Existing native Failure envelope

cases.given: Browser lease is current, connector lease expired, and an agent has a stored final locally.
cases.when: Observe presence and request dispatch; then reconnect the original authorized device.
then: No claim that the agent died or work failed
No new permit while disconnected
Stored final can be exported without another delivery

cases.given: The human approved a pending device with a five-minute expiry.
cases.when: Attempt claim with the displayed code alone, wrong secret, correct secret, and a repeated correct claim; repeat after expiry.
then: Code and wrong secret cannot claim or consume approval
Only the originating secret obtains scoped credentials once
Expired pending approval creates no usable device
No human refresh token or bearer URL emitted

cases.given: One dispatch mapping and native prepare committed in one local transaction; sending has not begun.
cases.when: Kill the connector process and restart with the same dispatch.
then: Same native request and attempt IDs reused
At most one observed transport delivery
Fault before commit leaves neither half of the mapping/prepare

cases.given: The native sending marker committed; the transport outcome is unknown.
cases.when: Kill/restart before and after the actual transport effect, including a lost cloud report.
then: No automatic resend or reassignment in either window
Projection remains uncertain until existing evidence resolves it
Delivery counter proves no extra effect after restart

cases.given: The assigned device has an unexpired Firebase token; its revocation is committed.
cases.when: Request a new permit or upload the stored final using the old token.
then: 403 for both operations
Native final remains local
Already delivered work is not claimed cancelled
Newly paired device cannot inherit the old dispatch

cases.given: A native immutable final exists but export is not approved or exceeds the wire bound.
cases.when: Reconcile final status twice.
then: No private body or truncation sent to cloud
Withheld projection, not failed execution
No rerun, same complete native final retained

cases.given: Two agents are adjacent; neither opted into social chat.
cases.when: Move them together, then explicitly start a consented finite session.
then: Movement alone causes no model call or tool use
Consented session stops at the first duration, turn or cost limit
No private workspace tools by default

cases.given: An invited visitor can view but not edit another owner's board object.
cases.when: Try an edit, grant object-scoped editing, then race two edits against one revision.
then: Unauthorized edit denied
One authorized compare-and-set wins, stale edit conflicts
No script, external URL or arbitrary HTML executed

cases.given: America/New_York schedule opens 01:00-02:00; a queue exists.
cases.when: Evaluate both 2026-11-01 01:30 occurrences, the 02:00 boundary, and manual closure; separately test the 2026-03-08 02:30 gap.
then: Both repeated 01:30 occurrences match; 02:00 does not
Nonexistent gap minute never opens
Manual closure prevents new permits without discarding queued work

cases.given: Review request is bound to the example headSha.
cases.when: A new PR head arrives before feedback is displayed.
then: Feedback retains its exact reviewed SHA and is labelled stale for the new head
No automatic GitHub approval, comment or merge

cases.given: Two isolated owner devices publish selected agents to one private deployment; a third account is not invited.
cases.when: Invite the second human, admit one review, deliver one native request, publish an approved final, revoke membership and reconnect.
then: One delivery and original immutable final observed end to end
Third account never gains world access
Revocation denies subsequent access and clears active private views
Installer and cloud cost evidence recorded separately from schema tests
